common_release_blocking_steps.expected_evidence: Fresh install or clean launch succeeds on release-channel artifact.
Client selects a Docker deployment at port 48027 without storing a private path or credential in diagnostics.
User signs in or completes device linking, then session revocation is handled without stale playback.
Library rows and media detail load from seeded representative data.
Playback starts through the native platform player and emits first heartbeat.
Progress heartbeat and stop/completion update server watch state.
Support bundle or diagnostics export omits credentials, signed URLs, and private paths.
Upgrade, rollback, or staged rollout halt path is documented for the release channel.

release_blocking_smoke: Start HLS playback and background/foreground once
Confirm push permission prompt copy when enabled
platforms.rollback_expectation: Halt staged rollout or publish higher versionCode hotfix; user downgrade is not assumed.
platforms.update_expectation: versionCode increases for every Play upload.
